comparison.objective: Clamp a glued panel closed with three clamps alternating above and below.
comparison.physical_skill: Place a loose clamp, slide jaws and regulate distributed clamping force while maintaining board alignment.
comparison.success_condition: Joint closed and level, three clamps snug in alternating pattern, no clamp above 6 N, robot released.
comparison.reason: Tests sustained preload distribution and clamp arrangement, not impulsive notch fracture, coaxial tool alignment or loose-fragment containment.
